learning_outcomes.text: Acquaint students with the problems of digital photography from the perspective of creating photographs, editing in the computer and publication.
Students will gain knowledge and experience with digital photography from the perspective of creating photographs, editing on a computer and publication.

syllabus_topics: Photography, introduction, history, personalities - Czech and world
Photo technique, construction and function of the camera, aperture, time, ISO
Perspective, light, white balance, color models, color management
assessment_rules: To obtain the credit it is necessary to pass a computer test. The assessment methods are a written examination and creative work analysis.
bibliography: LINDNER, P., MYŠKA, M. Velká kniha digitální fotografie. Brno, 2004. ISBN 80-251-0013-8.
degree: Bachelor's programme, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics - courses in English
